items.stem: Why does HR Service Delivery use a separate, scoped data model rather than the standard ITSM tables?

options.text: To keep sensitive employee data isolated and access-controlled
options.rationale: Correct: HR data is confidential, so it uses scoped tables with dedicated security.

options.text: Because ITSM tables cannot store text
options.rationale: ITSM tables can store text; isolation is for confidentiality, not capability.

options.text: To avoid using the CMDB entirely
options.rationale: CMDB relevance is unrelated to the reason for a scoped HR model.
HR uses workflows/flows like other applications.

items.stem: Which TWO are good practices for protecting sensitive HR records?

options.text: Apply ACLs that restrict access by HR role and COE
options.rationale: Correct: role- and COE-based ACLs enforce least-privilege on HR data.

options.text: Separate confidential cases from the general knowledge base
options.rationale: Correct: keeping confidential content out of public KBs prevents exposure.

options.text: Grant all agents the admin role for convenience
Store documents on a public portal page

options.rationale: Disabling auditing removes accountability and is unsafe for HR data.
